en.headline: LegCo passes Northern Metropolis Development Bill to accelerate project
en.dek: Lawmakers unanimously approved the dedicated legislation on Thursday after two days of debate, with the Development Bureau saying it will streamline planning and land procedures.
body: The Legislative Council passed the Northern Metropolis Development Bill on Thursday after lawmakers completed the third reading and voted unanimously in favour following about eight hours of debate over two days.

Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said the passage came one and a half months ahead of the government’s initial schedule. She described the bill as crucial to the mega project and the city’s future development, adding that it would lay a solid foundation for targets in Hong Kong’s first five-year plan.

Linn said the Northern Metropolis brought unlimited opportunities as well as challenges, and that the government would introduce further legislation as needed as construction entered different phases. Authorities would aim to submit subsidiary legislation in January so that facilitation measures could take effect in the first quarter of next year.
The bill is the first legislation dedicated to a single area in the city. It is intended to ease barriers on planning and land procedures for the development near the border with mainland China.

zh.headline: 立法會三讀通過北部都會區發展條例草案 加快項目推進
zh.dek: 議員經過兩日辯論後於周四一致通過這項專屬法例，發展局表示將有助簡化規劃及地政程序。
body: 立法會於周四完成三讀並一致通過《北部都會區發展條例草案》，議員在兩日內就草案進行約八小時辯論。
發展局局長甫漢豪表示，草案通過較政府原定時間表提前一個半月，形容這是北部都會區大型項目及香港未來發展的重要一步，並為香港首個五年規劃目標奠定基礎。
甫漢豪指出，北部都會區帶來無限機遇亦有不少挑戰，政府會因應項目進入不同階段適時引入新法例或修訂條例。當局會爭取明年一月提交附屬法例，以便利措施於明年第一季生效。
這是本港首項為單一區域制定的專屬法例，旨在簡化鄰近內地邊界發展區的規劃及土地程序。
